verdict.rationale: Insomnia has no documented AI-training policy or opt-out. It does offer storage options that keep project data from being readable by Insomnia: end-to-end encrypted Cloud Sync, where the servers cannot read project data, plus Git Sync and Local Vault, where data stays in your own repo or machine. That indirectly limits what the vendor could train on, but the AI features (mock generation, commit message suggestions) are not covered. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that user data is not used for AI training, a documented opt-out control, data-handling terms for the AI features, and independent corroboration.
